info.title: Ambivo Automations API
info.description:
Automation rules engine and workflow integration for Ambivo CRM.

## Authentication
All endpoints require a Bearer JWT token in the `Authorization` header.

## Response Pattern
- **Success**: `{ "result": 1, ...data }`
- **Error**: `{ "result": 0, "error": "message" }`

## Architecture Overview

Entity CRUD events flow through: Entity Service -> AutomationRulesService -> (WorkflowTriggerService OR legacy execute_action) -> automation_rules_execution_log

## How It Works

1. **Entity CRUD events** (lead create, contact update, etc.) trigger `evaluate_automation_rules()` asynchronously via `asyncio.create_task()`
2. The service loads all active automation rules matching the entity type and event name
3. For each rule:
   - If the rule has a `workflow_id`, execution is delegated to the **AI Workflow System** via `WorkflowTriggerService`
   - Otherwise, each action in `action_list` is evaluated against conditions (`match_criteria_dict`, `match_updated_fields_dict`) and executed if matched
4. Every evaluation (executed or skipped) is logged to `automation_rules_execution_log`

## Entity Types

Standard entities: `lead`, `contact`, `account`, `opportunity`, `order`, `invoice`, `task`, `user`, `fax`, `call_incoming`, `property`

Custom module entities use `is_custom_module_entity: true` with the custom collection name as `entity_type`.

## Event Types

| Event | Trigger | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `create` | New record created | `instance_payload` = full entity data |
| `update` | Record updated | Includes `updated_fields_dict` with before/after |
| `delete` | Record deleted | `instance_payload` = deleted record data |
| `background_process` | Cron schedule | Uses `cron_str`, processes batches of records |

## Available Actions

| Action | Description |
|---|---|
| `send_email` | Send email via tenant's email service |
| `send_sms` | Send SMS via tenant's phone service |
| `send_notification` | In-app + push notification |
| `send_data_email` | Email with aggregated data attachment |
| `send_data_sms` | SMS with aggregated data link |
| `send_data_notification` | Notification with aggregated data |
| `create_lead` | Create a new lead record |
| `create_opportunity` | Create a new opportunity |
| `create_appointment` | Create calendar event |
| `create_task` | Create a task for a user |
| `create_task_from_sequence` | Create tasks from a predefined sequence |
| `add_to_campaign` | Add entity to marketing campaign |
| `add_tags` | Add tags to entity record |
| `update_record` | Update fields on the entity |
| `call_api` | HTTP call to external API |
| `create_payment_intent` | Create Stripe payment intent |
| `create_invoice_intuit` | Create invoice in QuickBooks |
| `store_response_as_pdf` | Convert entity data to PDF |
| `sync_to_sparkapt` | Sync contact to SparkAPT |
| `paypal_payment_received` | Process PayPal webhook event |
| `create_insurance_policy` | Create insurance policy record |

## Condition System

Each action supports two independent condition types (AND logic):

**`match_criteria_dict`** — MongoDB query operators against current entity state:
```json
{"$and": [{"lead_status": {"$eq": "open"}}, {"amount": {"$gte": 1000}}]}
```
Supported operators: `$eq`, `$ne`, `$gt`, `$lt`, `$gte`, `$lte`, `$in`, `$nin`, `$regex`, `$exists`, `$or`, `$and`, `$nor`

**`match_updated_fields_dict`** — Field change matching (update events only):
```json
{"lead_status": {"before": "*", "after": "assigned"}}
```
`"*"` = wildcard (any value). All fields must match (AND logic).

## Template Variables

Action `args_payload` fields support `{{variable}}` interpolation:
- **Entity fields**: `{{first_name}}`, `{{email}}`, `{{phone}}`, `{{status}}`
- **Tenant context**: `{{tenant_name}}`, `{{tenant_id}}`, `{{current_ts}}`
- **Nested access**: `{{product_dict_list.0.renewal_date}}`

## Initial Delay

Actions can be delayed via `initial_delay` (seconds):
- `0` = immediate execution
- `> 60` = scheduled as background job via `tenant_scheduled_task`
- Supports expressions: `"n_minutes|5|5 * 60"`, `"expr({{appointment_ts}} - {{current_ts}} - 3600)"`

## AI-Powered Generation

Natural language automation generation is available via the [Autonomous Agents API](/docs/autonomous-agents):
- `POST /agent/automation/generate` — Convert description to automation rules
- `POST /agent/automation/refine` — Modify rules via feedback
- `POST /agent/automation/explain` — Get plain English explanation

tags.name: Smart Task Agent
tags.description:
Natural language task management via SmartTaskAgent.
Create, list, update, assign, complete, and delete tasks through conversational chat.
Uses `/user_tasks` REST API internally.

tags.name: Smart Data Import Agent
tags.description:
Conversational CSV data import via SmartDataImportAgent.
Multi-turn workflow: entity type selection → CSV fetch → auto field mapping → review → submit.
Uses `/user/data_import/manage` internally.

tags.name: Smart E-Sign Agent
tags.description:
Natural language e-signature operations via SmartESignAgent.
Manage contract templates, send for signature, track status, generate signing links, download evidence.

tags.name: Smart Research Agent
tags.description:
Lead/company enrichment and topic research via SmartResearchAgent.
Async workflow (~15 min) via vectordbapi `/pgv/research` pipeline.

get.description:
Retrieve automation rules for the authenticated user's tenant.
Supports pagination, filtering, sorting, and text search.

automation_rules.description: When a lead is created, add to campaign

post.description:
Create a new automation rule. The rule will be evaluated whenever a matching
entity event occurs.

This endpoint also supports two special actions via the `action` field:
- `"simulate"` — Test rules against sample data without executing (see Simulation tag)
- `"execute_background_process"` — Manually trigger a background process rule (see Background Processes tag)

value.description: Send SMS when a lead is created

automation_rule_id.description: ID of the created rule (create action)

patch.description:
Update an existing automation rule. Only the fields provided in `payload` are updated.

Common use cases:
- Toggle `is_active` to enable/disable a rule
- Update `action_list` to change actions or conditions
- Set `workflow_id` to delegate execution to the AI Workflow System

automation_rule_id.description: ID of the rule to update

link_workflow.summary: Link rule to AI Workflow System

delete.description:
Delete one or multiple automation rules.

- `action: "delete"` with `automation_rule_id` — delete a single rule
- `action: "delete_many"` with `automation_rule_ids` — delete multiple rules

post.description:
Trigger a workflow in the AI Workflow System from within ambivo_api.
Used by agents and internal services to start workflow executions with entity context.

workflow_id.description: ID of the workflow to trigger

context.description: Context data passed to the workflow

initial_delay.description: Seconds to delay before execution (0 = immediate)

post.description:
Receive a callback when a workflow execution completes.
Data is stored in Redis with a 1-hour TTL and published to the
`agent_events:{callback_session_id}` Redis channel.

callback_session_id.description: Session ID matching the original trigger request

get.description:
Retrieve the execution history of automation rules. Results are grouped by
`event_execution_thread_id` so all actions from a single rule evaluation
appear together.

Each log entry records whether the action was executed or skipped, the match
criteria result, any errors, and the response payload.

execution_log.message: action ignored as no criteria match!

post.summary: Chat directly with a specific smart agent
post.description:
Bypasses the supervisor routing and sends a message directly to a named agent.
Supports multi-turn conversations via `session_id` (Redis-backed memory).

Available agent types:
- `SmartTaskAgent` — Task management (create, list, update, assign, complete, delete)
- `SmartDataImportAgent` — CSV data import (multi-step: entity type → CSV → map → submit)
- `SmartESignAgent` — E-signature operations (templates, send, status, signing links)
- `SmartResearchAgent` — Lead/company enrichment and topic research (~15 min async)

value.message: Create a task to call back John Doe, due tomorrow, high priority
Import accounts from CSV https://example.com/data.csv, map phone_number to phone_list
Send the NDA template to alex@acme.com
Research John Smith at Coca Cola

post.summary: Create, submit, or execute a data import job
post.description:
Unified data import endpoint. Supports three actions:
- `add` — Create a draft import job
- `submit` — Execute a previously created job
- `import` — Shorthand for add + auto-execute

SmartDataImportAgent calls this with `action: "import"` after field mapping.

Processing modes:
- ≤30 records: synchronous
- 31–3,000 records: async (Celery)
- >3,000 records: batch (Celery, 2K-record chunks)

get.summary: Get valid status/stage values for entity types
get.description:
Returns the list of acceptable status or stage values for one or all entity types.
Used by SmartDataImportAgent to validate imported data before submission.
Invalid values default to `"open"` (status entities) or `"draft"` (stage entities).

Response also includes a `stages` field (and the alias `values_meta`)
with per-entry metadata (`label / color / is_seeded / is_overridden /
position / entity_custom_stage_id?`); see the CRM spec
(`ambivo-crm.openapi.yaml -> GET /entity/status-values`) for the full
contract including tenant override semantics.

parameters.name: entity_type
parameters.description: Specific entity type (omit for all types)

session_id.description: Session ID for multi-turn conversation memory (Redis-backed)

tenant_scope.description: If true, query across all tenant users (admin only)

entity_type.description: Agent entity type (task, data_import, esign, research)

decision.description: LLM decision metadata (action, confidence, reasoning, parameters)

data.description: Result data (array for list, object for single)

questions.description: Follow-up questions when status is more-info-needed

follow_up_actions.description: Suggested next actions for the client

action_data.description: Phone, email, or address for the action

subject_type.description: CRM entity type this task is about

raw_import_list.description: Array of raw CSV rows as JSON objects

entity_type.description: The full list is `IMPORTABLE_ENTITY_TYPES` in Core `service/import_key_flows.py`; any other built-in type is refused with `ENTITY_TYPE_NOT_IMPORTABLE`. `invoice` creates invoices (until 2026-09-26 it created orders) and is never sent to Stripe. `bill` creates vendor bills through the same writer as `POST /user/bill/manage`.

field_mappings_dict.description: Map entity fields → CSV column names, e.g. `{"first_name": "First Name"}`. For `invoice` and `bill`, map `line_<key>` fields (`line_description`, `line_qty`, `line_unit_price`, `line_amount`, `line_product_name`) and each row becomes a line.

line_group_config.description: `{enabled, group_by}`. Rows that share a key become one record with all their lines. The key for `invoice` is `invoice_num`; for `bill`, `bill_number`.

defaults.description: `account` only. A value for every blank cell of a field, e.g. `{"relationship_type": "vendor"}` so a vendor list is not saved as customers. camelCase keys are accepted. Refused with `INVALID_IMPORT_OPTION` for a bad value.

on_duplicate.description: `account` only. `skip`: a company whose email is already on file is left out, with a warning naming it; a run where every row is on file completes. `create`: a second company tagged "duplicate email".

opening_balance.description: `invoice` and `bill` only. The documents are already in the opening trial balance, so Books never posts them. Each is saved open (invoice) or pending (bill), with `books_accounting_status: not_required` and `is_opening_balance: true`; a row in any other stage is refused. Aging and payments still see them.

effective_ts.description: Epoch timestamp of last background_process run

workflow_id.description: If set, delegates to AI Workflow System instead of legacy actions

action_explanation_str.description: Auto-generated English explanation of the rule's actions

ActionDefinition.description: A single action within an automation rule

initial_delay.description:
Delay before execution (seconds). Formats:
- `0` = immediate
- `300` = 5 minute delay
- `"n_minutes|5|5 * 60"` = pipe-delimited (label|value|expression)
- `"expr({{appointment_ts}} - {{current_ts}} - 3600)"` = dynamic expression

match_criteria_dict.description:
MongoDB query filter evaluated against current entity state.
Supports `$eq`, `$ne`, `$gt`, `$lt`, `$gte`, `$lte`, `$in`, `$nin`, `$regex`, `$exists`, `$or`, `$and`, `$nor`.

match_updated_fields_dict.description:
Field change conditions (update events only). Each field specifies
required before/after values. `"*"` = wildcard (any value).
All fields must match (AND logic).

args_payload.description:
Action-specific arguments. Supports `{{variable}}` template interpolation.
See action-specific schemas below.

CallApiArgs.description:
`args_payload` for `call_api` action.
URL must pass `is_acceptable_host()` validation (private IPs, localhost, and certain domains are blocked).

userid.description: User to assign the task to

due_date_offset_minutes.description: Due date as offset from current time (minutes)

update_value.description: New value (string, number, or dict for multiple fields)

executed.description: Whether the action was actually executed

event_execution_thread_id.description: Groups all actions from one rule evaluation. Format: `{entity_type}_{event_name}_{epoch_ms}_{uuid_hex8}`

updated_fields_dict.description: Actual fields that were updated (for update events)

entity_updated_id.description: ID of the entity that triggered the evaluation

delegated_to_workflow.description: `true` when execution was delegated to AI Workflow System

workflow_id.description: Link to AI Workflow System (skips legacy actions)

SimulateRequest.description:
Test automation rules against sample data without executing actions.
Useful for validating rule conditions before going live.

instance_payload.description: Sample entity data to test against

ExecuteBackgroundProcessRequest.description: Manually trigger a background process automation rule
